agent.unexpected_context_overflow: record failure; no hidden changes to truncation or budget
accepted_action_formats: one Qwen XML bash/command tool call

factor_definitions.roundtrip: After an executed action, render the validated command as assistant.tool_calls and its recorded observation with role=tool. Preserve prose and exact command/observation content. System/error prompts, tool schema, strict action parser, model and budgets unchanged. Bundles call and result serialization; does not isolate their individual effects.

ordering: All24 already observed tasks in original015 order; alternate schema/roundtrip first per task; one loaded unchanged base, no cross-request KV cache.
primary: Paired historical regression success and regressions across all24 tasks. No fresh holdout or generalization claim.

exposure.all_tasks: All24 already observed in015; inherited14holdout now historical. No task descriptions, mutations, graders or snapshots changed. Only split/evaluation_role relabeled to historical. The known new-json-undefined regression motivated this intervention.

promotion.meaning: Diagnostic candidate only; a new independently frozen holdout is required for a generalization or adoption claim.

source_workspace_exclusions.ljharb/qs: Omit dist bundle, an unmodified duplicate of target source, from agent/grader snapshots

failure_policy: Preserve controller failures. Recovery only at completed-step boundaries with unchanged artifacts and original deadline. Never rerun a scored task or tune after scoring.
